semantic.justification: Actual source lifecycle/selection/notification member bodies use mandatory real EditDoc, ParaPortionList, InternalEditStatus, outer engine and source view declarations. Class is abstract: no original constructor is pretended and no production parser/undo/layout/style/view/application provider is supplied. Real SfxListener and StyleSheetUser role preserve model-use true. InitDoc keeps exact listener/owner reset/paragraph callback/spelling order. RemoveText, EnableUndo, SetText, DocModified, TextModified and ParaAttribsChanged retain ordering, source undo restoration on normal return only, old-height invalidation, upper-only selection clipping, current-node lookup and following-valid-paragraph CalcHeight call. Original insertion compensation updates both endpoints eagerly. Original non-YRS regular deletion update remains disabled by upstream #if0/FIXME. Remaining protected fields/callees are required abstract declarations, not no-op defaults. Actual full ImpInsertText orchestration now replaces the abstract parser declaration: original compound undo calls, range deletion/word service dependencies, SAL line normalization/fuzz-only tab replacement, exact existing capacity block, actual text/tab features, source paragraph splits/invalidation and final selection update/notification order. Actual ImpInsertParaBreak overloads retain paragraph-limit identity return, real style listener, source strict misspell-copy/truncation behavior, real portion insertion, attribute invalidation/callback and final selection/notification order. Original InsertText and active-view getter bodies are included. Source original initial invalidation index, retained left misspell copies and ClearWrongs overrun remain preserved as CALC-435..437. Enclosing class remains abstract: source constructor, undo manager and other mandatory dependencies have no production substitutes. Original complete InitScriptTypes/GetItemScriptType algorithms now consume actual field display units, source BreakIterator script queries, hint traversal, direction/script scanners and actual cached vectors. Native missing-portion/empty-node handling, field representative selection, one-unit supplementary behavior, gapped-hint lookup, endpoint-only membership/caret bias and one final language fallback are preserved (CALC-424/441..443). Actual orientation/default-language/scaling/paper/ref-device getters, GetEmptyItemSet, GetParaAttrib, IsRightToLeft and signed-integral GetColumnWidth retain original pool/default precedence and defined-arithmetic domain. Original CreateTextObject overload dispatch now delegates its private body to the same actual owner in impedit4.textobject; public object returns keep the EditTextObject base contract. BreakIterator factory and raw InitWritingDirections remain mandatory abstract dependencies, not default services. Concrete constructor/undo/layout/view/application/ScFieldEditEngine/DocImport admission and NatNum12 remain pending. Original complete InitWritingDirections now replaces the prior mandatory abstract declaration. It clears the same actual paragraph vector, reads raw actual node text, uses real ICU openSized/setPara/countRuns/getLogicalRun/close and exact source 0/1 direction. Both original error resets, count-driven logical traversal, missing-portion return, fuzzing skip and final LTR fallback remain unchanged. The test fixture observes then calls this actual method instead of preparing direction output. No reuse of the direction scanner with its extra control-boundary behavior, direction heuristic or fixed LTR provider is introduced. The class remains abstract: constructor, process BreakIterator factory, full undo/layout/view/application services and ScFieldEditEngine/DocImport admission are still pending. The source owner now includes actual UNO BreakIterator acquisition, word selection with its original cursor locale, source paragraph height and the lazy edit undo recording/reset group. EditDoc's actual SetText remains the plain-text path. Source layout switch and paragraph-attribute member dispatch now support the actual no-layout Calc document editor. Full layout, interactive selection-range editing and native device integration remain outside the document text-object slice.
